In Excel or Google Sheets\nIf your three players\u0027 scores are in cells **A1**, **B1**, and **C1**, you can use any of the following formulas to get the total of the top 2:\n\n*   **The Subtraction Method (Easiest):**\n    `\u003dSUM(A1:C1) - MIN(A1:C1)`\n*   **The \"LARGE\" Function Method:**\n    `\u003dLARGE(A1:C1, 1) + LARGE(A1:C1, 2)`\n    *(This specifically looks for the 1st highest and 2nd highest numbers and adds them together).*\n\n### 2.       "text": "\n\n\nBased on the logic used by **Bathbot** (the popular osu! multiplayer Discord bot), its Match Cost formula takes a different approach compared to traditional formulas. Instead of a flat ratio, Bathbot rewards players for map participation, versatility in mods, and gives extra weight to high-pressure tiebreakers.\n\nAccording to the developers and the bot\u0027s known source metrics, Bathbot’s Match Cost formula evaluates players based on four main criteria:\n1. **Score vs. Lobby Average**: How well a player scores on a map compared to the average score of everyone else in the lobby.\n2. **Tiebreaker Weighting**: Tiebreaker (TB) maps count for **double** the weight.\n3. **Participation Bonus**: Playing a higher percentage of the total maps rewards you with a multiplier (**up to 1.4x** for playing every map).\n4. **Mod Versatility**: Playing more than 2 different Mod combinations gives a slight bonus.\n5. **Minimum Floor**: The minimum Match Cost a player can receive is **0.5** (as long as they played at least 1 map).\n\nHere is the mathematical recreation of Bathbot\u0027s formula, followed by a script you can use for your players!\n\n### 🧮 The Bathbot Match Cost Formula\n\nFor a given player, calculate their Match Cost ($MC$) as follows:\n\n**1. Calculate their Weighted Average Performance ($P_{avg}$):**\n$$P_{avg} \u003d \\frac{\\sum (\\frac{\\text{Player Score}}{\\text{Lobby Avg Score}} \\times W)}{\\sum W}$$\n*(Where weight $W \u003d 2$ if the map is a Tiebreaker, and $W \u003d 1$ for a normal map)*\n\n**2. Calculate the Participation Multiplier ($M_{part}$):**\n$$M_{part} \u003d \\left( \\frac{\\text{Maps Played by Player}}{\\text{Total Maps in Match}} \\right) \\times 1.4$$\n\n**3. Calculate the Mod Multiplier ($M_{mod}$):**\nIf the player used more than 2 different mod combinations:\n$$M_{mod} \u003d 1.0 + (\\text{Unique Mods Played} - 2) \\times 0.05$$\n*(Otherwise, $M_{mod} \u003d 1.0$)*\n\n**4. Final Match Cost:**\n$$MC \u003d \\max(0.5, \\ P_{avg} \\times M_{part} \\times M_{mod})$$\n\n---\n\n### 💻 Python Implementation for Your Players\nSince you have a lobby of 3 players playing a \"Best of 3\" format, here is a Python script that perfectly models this exact Bathbot formula for your members:\n\n```python\ndef calculate_bathbot_matchcost(player_stats, total_maps_in_match):\n    match_costs \u003d {}\n    \n    # 1. First, calculate the lobby average score for each map\n    map_averages \u003d {}\n    for map_id in range(1, total_maps_in_match + 1):\n        scores \u003d [stats[\"maps\"][map_id][\"score\"] for player, stats in player_stats.items() if map_id in stats[\"maps\"]]\n        map_averages[map_id] \u003d sum(scores) / len(scores) if scores else 0\n        \n    # 2. Calculate Bathbot Match Cost for each player\n    for player, stats in player_stats.items():\n        played_maps \u003d stats[\"maps\"]\n        \n        if not played_maps:\n            match_costs[player] \u003d 0.0\n            continue\n            \n        total_ratio \u003d 0\n        total_weight \u003d 0\n        unique_mods \u003d set()\n        \n        for map_id, map_data in played_maps.items():\n            score \u003d map_data[\"score\"]\n            is_tb \u003d map_data.get(\"is_tb\", False)\n            mod \u003d map_data.get(\"mod\", \"NM\")\n            \n            # Tiebreakers count for double weight\n            weight \u003d 2 if is_tb else 1\n            \n            # Map performance ratio compared to lobby average\n            ratio \u003d score / map_averages[map_id]\n            \n            total_ratio +\u003d (ratio * weight)\n            total_weight +\u003d weight\n            unique_mods.add(mod)\n            \n        # Base Average Performance\n        p_avg \u003d total_ratio / total_weight\n        \n        # Participation Multiplier (up to 1.4x for playing 100% of maps)\n        m_part \u003d (len(played_maps) / total_maps_in_match) * 1.4\n        \n        # Mod Versatility Multiplier (Bonus if \u003e 2 mods)\n        m_mod \u003d 1.0\n        if len(unique_mods) \u003e 2:\n            m_mod +\u003d (len(unique_mods) - 2) * 0.05\n            \n        # Calculate Final Cost and apply the 0.5 minimum floor\n        raw_mc \u003d p_avg * m_part * m_mod\n        match_costs[player] \u003d max(0.5, round(raw_mc, 3))\n        \n    return match_costs\n\n# \u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\n# Example usage for your 3 Players\n# \u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\u003d\ntotal_match_maps \u003d 3\n\nplayers_data \u003d {\n    \"Player 1\": {\n        \"maps\": {\n            1: {\"score\": 850000, \"mod\": \"NM\", \"is_tb\": False},\n            2: {\"score\": 600000, \"mod\": \"HD\", \"is_tb\": False},\n            3: {\"score\": 920000, \"mod\": \"NM\", \"is_tb\": True} #         "text": "4\u003e0, (B4/AVERAGEIF($B4:$D4,\"\u003e0\"))*2,"
      }, {
        "text": " 0)) / ((B2\u003e0)*1 + (B3\u003e0)*1 + (B4\u003e"
      }, {
        "text": "0)*2)) * (COUNTIF(B2:B4,\"\u003e0\")/3) * 1."
      }, {
        "text": "4))\n```\n\n### 📋 How to use it:\n1. Paste the formula above into **B5** (under"
      }, {
        "text": " Player 1).\n2. Click on the cell, grab the little square in the bottom-right corner, and **drag it"
      }, {
        "text": " horizontally** to **C5** and **D5**. Excel will automatically adapt the formula for Player 2 and Player"
      }, {
        "text": " 3!\n3. *(If a player skipped a map or didn\u0027t play, just leave their score blank or type"
      }, {
        "text": " `0` and the formula will perfectly adjust the participation nerfs and lobby averages just like Bathbot!)*\n\n*(Note: If"
      }, {
        "text": " your version of Excel uses a different region setting and complains about the commas, just replace all the commas `,` in the formula with semicol"
      }, {
        "text": "ons `;`)*"
